top_signals.title: World Bank Warns Asia Is Running Out of Money to Fight Energy Shock
top_signals.summary: Asian countries have responded more aggressively than others to the energy supply crunch caused by the U.S. and Israeli war on Iran and now they are running out of resources to continue their response, the World Bank warned in a new report.
